meta.title: knowcard
meta.description: Flip a knowledge point over and keep images, video, blogs, documents, audio, and files on the back.

home.title: Turn a knowledge point over.
home.lead: The front holds the definition. The back gathers images, video, blogs, documents, audio, and files.

list.title: Cards
list.lead: Each card is one knowledge point. Open it and flip to the back on the same page.
list.emptyBody: Create one, then add https links on the back.
list.createLead: A title and a definition are enough. Add resources on the back.

library.title: Library
library.lead: Categories hold groups. Groups hold cards.
library.emptyBody: Create a category, then add a group inside it.
library.categoryCount: {groups, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}} · {cards, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}
library.groupEmptyBody: Create a card. The front holds the definition. Resources go on the back.
library.allLead: Every card belongs to one group.
library.noGroupBody: Go back to the library and create a category and a group before adding a card.
library.allEmptyBody: Choose a group, then add a title and a definition.
library.noOtherGroupBody: Create another group before copying or moving a card.
library.deleteEmptyCategory: Delete the category “{title}”. This cannot be undone.
library.deleteEmptyGroup: Delete the group “{title}”. This cannot be undone.
library.deleteCardBody: Delete the card “{title}”. This cannot be undone.
library.deleteCategoryCascade: Delete “{title}”. This will also delete {groups, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}} and {cards, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}. This cannot be undone.
library.deleteGroupCascade: Delete “{title}”. This will also delete {cards, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}. This cannot be undone.

studio.emptyBody: Add an https link. Files are not uploaded here.
studio.httpsHint: Only https links are accepted. Nothing is uploaded.
studio.deleteBody: Remove this link from the card. The page it points to stays where it is.

errors.invalid_url: That is not a valid link.
errors.not_found: That card or resource could not be found.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This card may be gone, or the address is wrong.
